errors.evidence: The x-axis represents specific percentage values (1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, 100%) which are not plotted on a linear scale.
The x-axis range starts from 1%, not 0%.
The x-axis does not have a constant step size; the tick marks are at 1%, 5%, 10%, 20%, 50%, 80%, and 100%.
The visible y-axis range is from 80 to 94.
The y-axis major tick interval is 2 (e.g., 80, 82, 84).
At the start of the x-axis (1%), the F1-score is 80.42, not 86.39. The value 86.39 corresponds to the 5% mark.
At the end of the x-axis (100%), the F1-score is 93.01, not 92.83. The value 92.83 corresponds to the 50% mark.

errors.text_span: 在x轴的1%处F1-score为86.42，在5%处F1-score为90.86，在10%处F1-score为91.96，在20%处F1-score为92.38，并在100%处达到92.83
errors.evidence: The description systematically mismatches the x-axis categories with their corresponding y-values. For example, at 1%, the F1-score is 80.42, not 86.42. At 5%, the score is 86.39, not 90.86. At 10%, the score is 90.88, not 91.96. The description appears to be assigning the value of the next data point to the current one.
